title: Spindle Speed Deviation — Encoder Signal Degraded
description: Actual spindle speed deviates from commanded speed by >{val} RPM for >500 ms. Encoder signal shows {val2} missing pulses per revolution.
probable_cause: Encoder disc contamination, bearing play causing encoder misalignment, or encoder cable shield failure causing EMI.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect cable routing for pinch points
Check cable shield continuity to ground
remedy: Clean or replace encoder. Re-route cable away from power cables. Re-commission speed loop.
required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.
escalation_path: If SPN-SR-002 is not addressed (complete current cycle then stop. schedule maintenance within 4 hours.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-CR-003, then SPN-MJ-002, then CNC-MD-011. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
